breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly instructed treating the internal torque as a single algebraic sum over the full length. The generated specification correctly removes this instruction and instead explicitly divides the shaft into two segments (0→800 mm and 800→1200 mm), computing the internal torque separately for each segment. This matches the ground truth approach of piecewise constant internal torque analysis.
